label: Enable remote access
help: Off by default. While off, no query is sent to any provider.

label: Provider
help: The one service this node contacts. Wikipedia needs no key; Brave and SerpAPI need an API key in the wallet; SearXNG needs your instance URL.

label: API key (wallet)
help: Wallet reference holding the Brave subscription token or the SerpAPI key, never the key itself.

label: SearXNG instance URL
help: Base URL of your SearXNG instance. Its settings must list json in search.formats.

label: Allow private network
help: Allow a SearXNG instance on loopback or a private LAN address. Link-local and cloud metadata addresses stay refused.

label: Allow plain HTTP
help: Allow an http:// SearXNG URL. Queries then travel unencrypted; use it only on a trusted network.

label: Results per search
help: Default number of results; a query can ask for 1 to 20.

label: Language
help: Default language code such as en, fr or pt-br. Empty: provider default (English Wikipedia).

label: Region
help: Default two-letter country code such as US or FR. Empty: provider default.

label: Safe search
help: Default adult-content filter. SerpAPI sends no filter for Moderate (Google default).

label: Time range
help: Default freshness filter. Wikipedia search has none.

label: Search deadline (s)
help: Total time for one search, including SearXNG pages and retry waits.

label: SearXNG pages per search
help: Most SearXNG result pages one search may request to fill the asked results.

label: Retries
help: Retries after HTTP 429, HTTP 5xx or a network failure. Quota and key errors are never retried.

label: Longest retry wait (s)
help: A Retry-After above this value returns a rate_limited error instead of waiting.

label: Response size limit (bytes)
help: Larger provider responses are refused as protocol errors.

label: Text limit (characters)
help: Longest snippet or Wikipedia extract kept; longer text is cut at a word boundary.

label: API base URL (tests only)
help: Keep empty to use the official API. Only a loopback test double may replace it.

label: Custom CA file
help: Optional absolute PEM file for an https:// SearXNG instance or an HTTPS loopback test double. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
